metadata.title: [CHORE][SECURITY]: Enforce gRPC reflection descriptor limits incrementally during reflection
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
### 🔧 Chore Summary

`mcpgateway/services/grpc_service.py::_enforce_descriptor_limits()` (added in PR #3202) caps three things on reflected gRPC `FileDescriptorProto`:
- per-blob byte size (1 MiB)
- count (1024)
- aggregate byte size (8 MiB)

The limits work, but they run **after** the entire reflection response has been collected, deduplicated into a `set[bytes]`, and parsed into `FileDescriptorProto` objects. A malicious or compromised gRPC server can therefore force the gateway to allocate close to the aggregate cap before the rejection.

### ⚙️ Why now

PR #3202 mitigates this in practice by adding a per-call gRPC deadline (review B6) — a slow upstream gets cut off. But a fast malicious upstream that returns 8 MiB of garbage `FileDescriptorProto` payloads can still spike memory and CPU before the cap fires.

### 📐 Proposed fix

Move the size/count checks **inside** the `for file_desc_proto_bytes in resp.file_descriptor_response.file_descriptor_proto:` loop in `_perform_reflection`:

```python
running_total = 0
for file_desc_proto_bytes in resp.file_descriptor_response.file_descriptor_proto:
    if len(file_desc_proto_bytes) > _GRPC_MAX_DESCRIPTOR_BYTES:
        raise GrpcServiceError(...)
    running_total += len(file_desc_proto_bytes)
    if running_total > _GRPC_MAX_TOTAL_DESCRIPTOR_BYTES:
        raise GrpcServiceError(...)
    if len(file_descriptor_bytes_set) >= _GRPC_MAX_DESCRIPTOR_COUNT:
        raise GrpcServiceError(...)
    file_descriptor_bytes_set.add(file_desc_proto_bytes)
    # … existing parse + extract ...
```

Drop the post-loop `_enforce_descriptor_limits()` once the inline checks cover all three axes.

### 📋 Acceptance Criteria

- Per-blob, running-total, and count limits all checked before adding to the set.
- Limit-exceeded raises `GrpcServiceError` and `service.reachable = False` (matching current outer error handler).
- Unit tests:
  - server returns one oversized blob → caught at first blob, no later blob parsed
  - server returns N+1 small blobs → caught at blob N+1, no later blob parsed
  - cumulative total exceeds limit at blob K → caught at blob K, no later blob parsed
- The existing `TestSecurityHardening` tests in `tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_grpc_service.py` continue to pass against the new helper (or the helper's existing post-loop check is removed and tests adapted).

### 🔗 Context

- Source: deep-review of PR #3202, item #15 in [PR comment](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/pull/3202#issuecomment-4386420357).
- Adjacent code: `_enforce_descriptor_limits()` and `_perform_reflection()` in `mcpgateway/services/grpc_service.py`.
